meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浓缩代码改动为一句提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为提交信息措辞犯难,希望留下清晰记录。
copy.tagline_en: Condense code changes into one commit message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with commit messages and want clean history.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把提交信息写成 Conventional Commits 格式，只留意图、去掉废话，主题行尽量 ≤50 字符。它只输出可直接粘贴的信息文本，不运行 git、不暂存文件、不 amend。
howto.when: 当你提到 “write a commit”、“commit message” 或 /commit 等入口时触发。

say.text: 帮我写这次改动的 commit message
这是破坏性变更，提交信息里要写 BREAKING CHANGE
say.note: 破坏性变更会强制带上说明正文

say.text: 把这次修复写成一条简短的提交信息
say.note: 只给主题行，除非需要说明原因

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes commit messages in Conventional Commits format, compressed to intent only, with a subject line kept near 50 chars. It outputs a paste-ready code block only; it does not run git, stage files, or amend.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “write a commit”, “commit message”, or use /commit or /caveman-commit.

say_en.text: Write a commit message for these changes
say_en.note: Outputs a paste-ready Conventional Commits message

say_en.text: This is a breaking change, include BREAKING CHANGE
say_en.note: Breaking changes force a body section

say_en.text: Summarize this fix in one short commit message
say_en.note: Subject only unless a why is needed
